stable.notes: Every message row says where it came from. With server 6.43.4 a run the Mac started (the scheduled morning brief today, agent tasks next) carries a ROUTINE or TASK label in the Activity window Messages list and on the message detail line, with the model that answered beside it; the routine or task is named in the hover. Nothing is inferred from a row that carries no label. The Morning brief card shows why the last brief failed, on its own line. Pairs with server 6.43.4; on an older server rows carry no label.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
